TITLE: Tech View – Total Price Sits at the Left of Its Column Instead of the Right
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-10045 (Tech View — table grouped by lead technician; Ready for QA, read live 19 Oct 2026) · PRIORITY: Medium · LINK: relates to SV-10045
ALREADY REPORTED: none. JQL read live 19 Oct 2026: text ~ "Total price" OR summary ~ "tooltip" (30 days); label board-tech-view (3 days). SV-11325 (TESTING STAGE) is the number link, progress bar and advisor avatar under S2-R20, not Total price; SV-11420 (TESTING STAGE) is row text size.
BASIS: design only. PRD v64 (16 Oct 2026, read live 19 Oct) has no sentence on Total price alignment; S2-R20 says "Tech View’s cells follow the design" and S2-R23 left-aligns only Status, Waiting On Parts and Progress. The design file right-aligns Total price in Tech View at every density (14 Oct design inventory V0753/V0754: align right). QA lead 19 Oct 2026: "If the build going against the design if YES then create them too."
STATUS: APPROVED BY THE QA LEAD 19 Oct 2026 (design-based).

h2. Description

*In Tech View, the Total price amount should sit at the right of its column, as in the design.* On staging it sits at the left.

For example,
* a work order's total such as {{$173.98}} starts at the left edge of the Total price column
* the *Total Price* heading is at the left too
* in the design, amounts line up on the right so the dollar figures can be compared down the column

This differs from the design file for Tech View (Claude Design project "Work Orders", board "Work Orders.dc.html").

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then click *Tech View* in the display switcher.
# Scroll right to the *Total Price* column of any group's group.
#* Each amount starts at the left of the column.

*Actual Result:*
* Total Price amounts sit at the left of their column in Tech View.

*Expected Result:*
* As the test expects: *"Step 7: “Waiting On Parts” shows a grey dash (-), not a blank, and “Total price” sits at the right of its column."*
